claims.text: THE DOMAIN'S CLEANEST WORKED EXAMPLE OF MANUFACTURED CORROBORATION. Tal Levesque, author of the two original Dulce Base articles, told Adam Gorightly by email in November 2015 that Thomas Edwin Castello was 'a creation. A MYTH', and described the distribution: 'Literally, I made 100 large envelope packets with supporting material about Underground bases, genetic research, hidden science (R & D), etc. and sent the material to authors and lecturers, who then mixed it into their talks, articles and books.' The many later sources that agree about Dulce agree because they were seeded from one origin.

claims.text: THE CONFESSION. Tal Levesque, who wrote as Jason Bishop III, told Adam Gorightly by email in November 2015: 'You still do not get it. TEC (Thomas Edwin Castello) is a creation. A MYTH. I took rantings from a heavily drugged (with prescription pills) woman Ann West (a.k.a., Cherry Hinkle), made corrections to stuff that was really wrong, added my own real research, mixed it together. That was the basis of the two original DULCE BASE articles.' Tier 2 and not Tier 1 because the email was read as reproduced on Hayakawa's site quoting Gorightly's book, and neither the email nor the book was opened by this board.

claims.text: THE MECHANISM, AND THE REASON THIS NODE MATTERS TO THE BOARD'S OWN RULES. In the same message Levesque describes how the appearance of independent corroboration was produced: 'Literally, I made 100 large envelope packets with supporting material about Underground bases, genetic research, hidden science (R & D), etc. and sent the material to authors and lecturers, who then mixed it into their talks, articles and books.' This is a documented instance of many apparently separate sources sharing one method and one origin.
